amendments.definition: Separate final-only reporting from mandatory human approval and bind approval to the concrete proposal digest.
Preserve the capability review and every accepted amendment in both review projections.
Use typed resolution provenance and real source references for inferred and skill-constrained choices.
Keep literal prompts only in the concrete proposal and bind every task to one unique prompt id.
Type and bound every slot, isolate reviewer outputs, and enumerate the exact readable paths.
Bind writer and reviewer outputs to one exact candidate digest and keep the release barrier explicit.
Use requested runtime keys and least-authority command profiles restricted to exact scope or target.
Use canonical participant names and stable seat ids consistently across actor, profile, and task projections.
Separate per-task technical attempts from the bounded remediation review rounds and declare budgets and boundaries concretely.
Reject duplicate keys and compute local canonical digests under explicit nonportable scopes without self-reference.
